definitions: An imaginary belt in the heavens, extending on either side of the ecliptic, within which are the apparent paths of the sun, moon, and principal planets. It is divided into twelve equal parts, or signs, each named after a constellation.
A diagram or representation of the zodiac, used in astrology.
examples: Her birth chart showed many planets in the sign of Leo in the zodiac.
The ancient astrologers meticulously mapped the zodiac.
